description:
Fix two reproduced plan-alignment defects found in the current uncommitted zaq-1lw implementation. This issue records work for the implementing agent; no production changes made during review.
Plan: https://chatgpt.com/space/page_1e1079bf6234819185ccfa7aecefadc8
Target worktree: /Users/jad/Desktop/Jad/workspace/zaq/forks/jat10/zaq-feat-channel-files.
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, testing-approach.md, action-reuse.md, documentation.md and services/channels.md. Preserve existing working-tree implementation and dependency pins.

Functional specifications and files:
1. HIGH: lib/zaq/channels/delivery_executor.ex — run_uploads, run_sequential, root election in run_continue, and the run_ready singleton fast path invoke operations directly. Only the multi-step async_stream path enforces runtime.timeout. A blocked first root or sole remaining reply therefore prevents timeout reporting/continue progress. Apply the configured deadline consistently to every effectful step, including uploads and stop-policy publication, without retry or duplicate invocation. Preserve bounded concurrency, sequential stop execution, confirmed earlier outcomes and unconfirmed status after a started request times out. Continue must promote the next root after a timed-out root.
2. MEDIUM: lib/zaq/channels/delivery_files.ex — plan_groups chooses publication_operation by original group_id; only group 0 may edit an existing streamed message. If upload-request preparation eliminates group 0 completely, the first surviving group is planned as :send despite metadata.message_id and native attachment editing. Select the first eligible publication group for the existing-message edit. Preserve original attachment indices/group identity and failure evidence; do not renumber files, retry omitted files, or duplicate the streamed answer.

Tests to add before implementation:
Reuse test/zaq/channels/delivery_executor_test.exs for deterministic blocked-provider regressions: first threaded root timeout followed by promotion, single remaining reply timeout, sole publication, stop publication timeout preventing later steps, and upload timeout with no stop publication. Assert each operation starts at most once, task cleanup and unknown outcomes; use messages/monitors rather than sleep-based sequencing. Existing parallel timeout test must keep passing.
Reuse existing planner scenarios in attachment_policy_test.exs/delivery_files_test.exs, plus jido_chat_delivery_test.exs for actual integration if needed: existing streamed ID, native edit support, two message groups, every upload candidate in first group rejected before network I/O, second group valid. Expect one planned edit targeting the existing ID, no new answer post, and failed index 0 retained. Cover several omitted leading groups, partial first group, all omitted fallback, and no existing ID.
Review reproductions: /var/folders/hj/209gt2z12d1c2cf48t_2dc080000gn/T/zaq_plan_review_pirm9sg9_test.exs (temporary, may disappear). Evidence /tmp/zaq-plan-review-reproductions.log. Two timeout tests stayed blocked >250ms with timeout:10; planner test produced {:send,1} instead of edit to existing-streamed-message. These three tests failed against reviewed code; 70 existing focused checks passed. Recreate meaningful durable regressions in existing suites; do not rely on temporary files as final coverage.

Branches/paths: :continue/:abort, independent/threaded, root absent/present, one/multiple ready steps, upload/send/edit, preflight omission versus transport failure, confirmed versus unconfirmed effects.
Mocking: controlled bridge/provider-edge doubles and existing real internal planning/execution; no global dependency mutation, no replacement scheduler or transport pipeline.
Action reuse assessment: extend current DeliveryExecutor invocation/supervision and DeliveryFiles group selection. Reuse Zaq.TaskSupervisor and existing Step/result contracts. Timeout handling and first-eligible selection are Channel-local orchestration details, not Actions/tools. Existing materialization, authorization and provider APIs unchanged.
Documentation: update affected module docs and docs/services/channels.md only if guarantees need clarification. Record reproduction, RED/GREEN and validation in this issue.
Validation: focused existing suites, mix q and applicable workflow checks. Preserve existing assertions; disclose and obtain approval for any unexpected existing-test behavioral change. Final review zaq-1lw.12 depends on this fix; existing UX/E2E/coverage gates remain open.
Done: regressions pass, no duplicated operations/answers, all transport execution paths honor configured deadlines, and review evidence recorded. No commit/push/merge without authorization.

Contracts preserve once-only invocation, unknown timeout certainty, stop barriers, continue promotion and existing authorization/provider APIs. Add regressions in existing executor/planner suites before production edits. Initial RED log /tmp/zaq-1lw15-red.log proves five blocked execution paths and omitted-leading-group edit defect before production fixes. Added tests also cover sole send/edit in both placements, continue upload progress, several omitted groups property, partial first group, missing streamed ID, and actual Jido upload/edit plus all-omitted streamed-text fallback. All existing assertions retained; fixture observations and process-local error values made task-owner aware, per-test atomic counter preserves multi-operation transport state. Every upload/send/edit uses shared supervised run_steps, with bounded concurrency, cleanup and unknown certainty, sequential stop barrier and no retries. Existing streamed edit selected by first surviving group without renumbering. Module/service docs clarify guarantees. mix.exs and mix.lock byte-identical to start-of-task snapshots; no application commit/push/merge. Final epic review/E2E/coverage/precommit remain in their existing gated issues; no UX self-approval. Separate Mattermost gap work-pim.5 remains recorded and open.
